title: UnreadableRunList
description: Response of GET /v1/runs/unreadable (added in 3.2): every run directory in this core's store that the core cannot read, with the run id (the directory's name) and the reason. A run listed here is not absent and not failed: its state is unknown to this core. Listing it changes nothing in its directory. `runs.list` skips these runs; this is the one place that names them.

count.description: How many run directories cannot be read. Equals the length of `runs`.

run_id.description: The run directory's name, which is the run id. A directory whose name is not a run id is not a run directory and is not listed.

reason.description: `newer_version`: written by a newer store schema than this core reads (nothing in it is read past the version file, and nothing in it is changed). `corrupt_record`: the run's record file is missing, not JSON or not a run. `unreadable_log`: the event log is corrupt or cannot be read. `other`: any other reason (an unreadable version file, liveness that cannot be read); `detail` says which.

detail.description: The core's message about why, at most 500 characters. It is text from a directory the core does not control: show it escaped.
